OBJECT Codeunit 50004 Local TextConst
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=21.11.26;
    Time=12:00:00;
    Modified=Yes;
    Version List=TEST;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
  }
  CODE
  {
    VAR
      ExistingGlobal@1000 : Integer;

    PROCEDURE ShowMessage@1();
    VAR
      ConfirmMsg@1000 : TextConst 'ENU=Are you sure?;RUS=Вы уверены?';
      CountL@1001 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      // CAL004: ConfirmMsg must be promoted to global VAR
      ExistingGlobal := 1;
      CountL := ExistingGlobal;
      IF CONFIRM(ConfirmMsg) THEN
        MESSAGE('%1', CountL);
    END;

    BEGIN
    END.
  }
}
